source.balanced_rows_provenance: Reconstructed on compute node by job 25213164.pbs101 from Phase 2 prepared rows; use this source only and do not mix with the temporal-balanced-train cache.
source.balanced_base_reference_checkpoint_use: Provenance and reference only. Both current arms are reconstructed from the same frozen initialization and trained for the full 3000 updates; neither arm loads this terminal checkpoint.
source.preprocessing_isolation: Episode/task-level only. The official dataset-wide scaler reads train columns that can include selected evaluation episode rows; do not claim row-level preprocessing isolation.
source.source_version_boundary: Reuse existing staged official checkpoint and interface probe. Remote staging has no .git; historical commit provenance is not a currently verified HEAD. Exact current CEM source is saved as source_reference/cem.py and runtime source snapshots.

model.adapter: orthogonal Cayley initial identity, no dimensional reduction
model.action_window_padding: zero-left-pad prior consumed tokens; include current token; no future token
model.baseline_action_information_difference: Historical balanced_base directly sees only current action; main flat/block comparison shares recent3 consumed actions

objective.latent_loss: Existing mean-normalized horizon-weighted free-running latent MSE.
objective.score_loss: 0.1 * context-normalized teacher-score SmoothL1 mean; top-12 weight 2.0, remaining candidate weight 1.0, std floor 1e-6, beta 1.0.

latency.boundary: full5step predictor including rotations/message; exclude encoder CEM environment

evaluation.elite_selector: Actual staged native torch.topk(cost,k=30,largest=False), default sorted; old helper response metrics reused but top30/regret recomputed with native selector

contingent.stage_b: relative quality + cheap + integrity gate pass
contingent.stage_b_regret_definition: Teacher score of post-update student mean minus teacher score of post-update teacher mean; divided by the teacher round-1 candidate-score population std, floor1e-6.
contingent.stage_c: absolute predictor + Stage B stability gates pass

stage_b_native_update.scope: fixed-observation paired diagnostic, native update, not full official MPC lifecycle

contingent.stage_c_success_claim: Fresh paired50 tasks; compare global16 versus flat and teacher. Report exact success/failure counts, McNemar paired discordances/CI and planner latency. Improvement claim requires paired success gain with CI excluding0; pilot otherwise inconclusive. No result dependent task/checkpoint selection.

scope.current_target: architecture quality at cheap budget; success only measured if contingent closed-loop triggered
